description:

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Title: Lead – Data Migration (ITSM / ServiceNow)**

**Experience:** 9–10 Years

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Lead Data Migration Specialist** with strong **Python expertise** and proven experience in **migrating data across ITSM platforms**, particularly **ServiceNow**. This role will lead end-to-end data migration initiatives, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and seamless transition while managing stakeholders and technical teams.

Knowledge of **Salesforce platform** will be considered an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Migration Leadership**

* Lead and oversee **end-to-end data migration projects** from legacy ITSM tools to modern platforms (preferably ServiceNow).
* Define **data migration strategy, approach, and governance framework**.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams (developers, analysts, platform SMEs) to execute migration programs.

**Technical Execution**

* Design and implement **data extraction, transformation, and load (ETL) pipelines** using **Python**.
* Build reusable scripts and automation frameworks for **data validation, reconciliation, and error handling**.
* Work with structured and unstructured data across multiple data sources (databases, APIs, files).

**ServiceNow Expertise**

* Perform data migration into **ServiceNow modules** (Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB, etc.).
* Configure and utilize **ServiceNow import sets, transform maps, and integration tools**.
* Ensure **data model alignment** with ServiceNow standards and best practices.

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define **data cleansing, deduplication, and validation rules**.
* Ensure **data integrity, completeness, and compliance** throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Conduct reconciliation, auditing, and sign-off processes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand **data requirements and mapping**.
* Communicate project status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership.
* Provide guidance and best practices to internal teams.

**Delivery & Risk Management**

* Identify migration risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Ensure timely delivery aligned with project timelines and quality standards.
* Drive **continuous improvement and automation** in migration processes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 9–10 years of experience in **data migration, data engineering, or integration roles**.
* Proven track record of leading **large-scale ITSM data migration projects**.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in **Python** (data processing, scripting, automation).
* Hands-on experience with: **ETL tools and frameworks** SQL and relational databases Data mapping, transformation logic, and validation
* Experience with APIs, JSON, XML, and file-based data exchange.

**ITSM & ServiceNow**

* Hands-on experience in **ServiceNow data migration** (Import Sets, Transform Maps).
* Good understanding of **ITIL processes** and ITSM data structures.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Experience with **Salesforce platform** (data migration, integrations, or objects model).
* Exposure to **cloud platforms** (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Familiarity with data governance, compliance, and security standards.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong leadership and team management capabilities
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
* Effective communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

**Key Success Metrics**

* Successful completion of migrations with **high data accuracy and minimal defects**
* Adherence to timelines and delivery commitments
* Improved efficiency through automation and reusable assets

Sapience Edu Connect is an education technology company focused on personalized learning, one-to-one learning assistance, technology-enabled education and student development. We are looking for an enthusiastic AI & Technology Intern who is interested in software development, practical AI applications and solving real-world technical problems.

The selected candidate will work with our existing technology systems, particularly our Learning Management System (LMS), assist with debugging and testing, develop small software features, explore AI tools and build internal automation solutions.

* Understanding of web applications, APIs and databases.

title: Lead Product Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Lead Product Engineer to drive our product from first idea to live release and beyond. You will combine hands-on engineering with product ownership: owning the requirements, leading several engineering teams, and making sure what we build is technically sound and matches what customers and the business need.  
This role sits at the centre of product and engineering. You will turn business goals into a clear roadmap and technical plan, shape the architecture, guide teams through design, development, testing and release, and stay hands-on where it matters, through code reviews, prototypes and solving the hardest technical problems. You are accountable for quality, timelines and outcomes.

Key responsibilities  
1. Product development from start to finish

* Shape the product vision and roadmap with leadership, based on business goals, customer feedback and market research.
* Lead each product or feature through its full lifecycle: discovery, requirements, design, development, testing, release and post-launch review.
* Define the minimum viable product (MVP) and plan releases in phases.
* Decide what gets built, what waits and what is dropped, using clear prioritisation (value, effort, risk).
* Review released features against goals and plan improvements.
* 2. Requirements ownership
* Act as the single owner of product requirements and the product backlog.

* Gather requirements from customers, sales, support, operations and leadership; resolve conflicts between them.
* Write clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria that teams can build and test against.
* Keep the backlog refined, prioritised and ready at least two sprints ahead.
* Manage scope changes through a controlled change process and explain their impact on time and cost.
* Accept or reject completed work against the agreed acceptance criteria.

3. Managing multiple teams4. Technical oversight5. Delivery and stakeholder management

* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams: development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps and business analysis.
* Plan sprints and releases across teams; manage dependencies, shared resources and handoffs.
* Run or oversee Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Set clear goals for each team, track progress, and remove blockers quickly.
* Coach team members, give regular feedback, and support hiring and onboarding.
* Build a culture of ownership, quality and open communication.
* Work with architects and tech leads on solution design, technology choices and technical debt.
* Make sure non-functional needs are planned in: performance, security, scalability and reliability.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases and cloud basics well enough to judge trade-offs.
* Ensure quality through code review practices, test coverage and CI/CD standards.
* Own delivery timelines, budget and risks; raise issues early with options.
* Report progress, risks and results to leadership and stakeholders in plain language.
* Coordinate go-live with support, training, marketing and operations teams.
* Track product metrics and use data to guide decisions.Qualifications and skills

* Strong hands-on coding skills in at least one modern back-end stack (such as Java, Node.js) and working knowledge of a front-end framework (React or Angular).
* Experience designing scalable systems: microservices, REST or GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with Agile (Scrum or Kanban) and tools such as Jira, Confluence, ClickUp or Azure DevOps.
* Clear written and spoken communication in English; able to explain technical decisions to non-technical people.

title: Cloud Project Coordinator
description:
**Role Summary**

The Project Coordinator / Associate Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of Scaleios customer projects across Azure, Microsoft 365 and AWS. This is a dedicated project management role focused on driving projects to on-time completion - owning project onboarding and plans, managing timelines and stakeholders, flagging timeline lapses and escalations, calling out scope deviations, and ensuring smooth transitions from the Sales/PreSales phase through delivery and into Support. The role does not carry account management, upselling or marketing responsibilities. It is ideal for a structured, proactive individual who thrives on ownership, follow-through and cross-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

Project Planning & Timeline Management

* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for assigned projects throughout the lifecycle, from kick-off call to handover.
* Prepare and proactively maintain Project Plans in the project management tool (e.g., MS Planner) in coordination with the Technical Project Team and customer, capturing tasks, owners, effort and timelines.
* Drive projects to stay within the agreed delivery timeline, tracking milestones, dependencies and completion status with trackers kept updated in real time.

Stakeholder Management & Status Reporting

* Share regular project status reports with the respective stakeholders, including after every key meeting or decision point.
* Circulate Minutes of Meeting capturing decisions, action items and owners, and follow up to closure.
* Maintain proactive, clear communication with customers and internal teams (Technical, Sales, PreSales, Operations, Support) to keep everyone aligned.

Scope, Risk & Escalation Management

* Proactively identify and flag timeline lapses, risks and blockers to the Project Lead before they become escalations.
* Call out and formally report any scope creep or deviation in the proposed solution, in coordination with the Customer, Technical and Sales teams.
* Own and track project-level escalations to resolution, following the correct escalation matrix and communication path.

Project Onboarding, Handover & Transition

* Own the project onboarding process end to end - collect all required onboarding data from the Sales/Account Management team and follow the standard onboarding process for every assigned project.
* Conduct the project kick-off call, with onboarding and subsequent project activities commencing immediately thereafter.
* Conduct formal handover sessions for large projects and prepare handover documentation (solution overview, resource details, support scope, contacts and escalation matrix).
* Ensure a smooth transition into the Support team immediately after handover for customers who have opted for support, with all relevant details formally handed over.

Process Adherence & Documentation

* Ensure consistent use of the proper project management tools and processes across all assigned projects.
* Maintain complete, up-to-date internal project documentation, and help standardize and communicate the onboarding-to-handover process to the PreSales, Sales and BizOps teams.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Engineering, Business or a related field.
* 2-4 years of experience in project coordination or project management, preferably in IT / cloud services delivery.
* Working familiarity with cloud and Microsoft technologies (Azure, Microsoft 365, AWS) is a strong advantage.
* Hands-on proficiency with project management/tracking tools (MS Planner or equivalent) and Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Excel, SharePoint).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for status reporting, MoMs and customer-facing correspondence.
* Highly organised and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple concurrent projects, deadlines, and stakeholders.
* Strong sense of ownership, proactiveness and follow-through in flagging risks and driving projects to closure.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* A recognised project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM or Agile/Scrum) or willingness to obtain one.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure or migration projects (Azure/AWS/M365).
* Familiarity with SLAs, escalation matrices and support-transition processes.

title: NDT Technician
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled **NDT Technician** with experience in **shipbuilding, ship repair, marine, fabrication, or heavy engineering** to carry out non\-destructive testing and inspection of welds, structures, piping, and other components. The candidate should be familiar with NDT procedures, inspection standards, safety requirements, and preparation of accurate inspection reports.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform NDT inspections as per approved procedures, inspection plans, drawings, and applicable standards.
* Carry out **UT, DPT, MPT and/or RT** depending on qualification and project requirements.
* Inspect welds, plates, pipes, structural members, pressure components, and repaired areas.
* Identify and evaluate weld discontinuities, defects, cracks, porosity, lack of fusion, undercut, etc.
* Verify inspection areas and test locations as per approved drawings and inspection requirements.
* Calibrate and perform routine checks of NDT equipment before use.
* Record inspection results accurately and prepare NDT reports.
* Maintain proper documentation, inspection records, test reports, and traceability.
* Coordinate with **QA/QC, Welding, Production, and Project teams** for inspection activities.
* Conduct re\-inspection of repaired/reworked areas and verify compliance.
* Ensure NDT activities are carried out in accordance with applicable **class, client, statutory, and project requirements**.
* Maintain NDT equipment, accessories, consumables, and calibration records.
* Follow all applicable **HSE and radiation\-safety requirements**, particularly during RT activities.
* Support client/class surveyors during inspection and testing.
* Report inspection findings and non\-conformities to the concerned QA/QC Engineer or NDT Level II/III personnel.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma / ITI / Technical qualification in Mechanical, Welding, NDT, or a related field.
* Valid certification in relevant NDT methods such as:
* **UT – Ultrasonic Testing**
* **MT/MPI – Magnetic Particle Testing**
* **PT/DPT – Dye Penetrant Testing**
* **RT – Radiographic Testing**, if applicable
* Certification as per relevant **ASNT / ISO 9712 / PCN** or equivalent requirements will be preferred.
* Practical experience in **shipyard, ship repair, marine, fabrication, or heavy engineering** is preferred.

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of weld inspection and NDT techniques.
* Ability to interpret **engineering drawings, weld symbols, inspection procedures, and specifications**.
* Knowledge of relevant **ASME, ASTM, AWS, ISO and classification society requirements**.
* Familiarity with acceptance criteria for weld and material defects.
* Ability to prepare clear and accurate NDT reports.
* Basic computer knowledge for documentation and reporting.

Desired Competencies

* Strong attention to detail.
* Good observation and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a QA/QC team.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to work in **shipyard, dock, vessel, and outdoor environments**.
* Commitment to safety and quality standards.

Key Performance Areas

* Accuracy and reliability of NDT inspection.
* Timely completion of inspection activities.
* Proper identification and reporting of defects.
* Compliance with approved NDT procedures and applicable standards.
* Proper maintenance of inspection records and equipment.

title: Assistant Director, Information Governance
company: Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
description:
Executive Level 1
  
  

$122,620 \- $139,850 \+ 15\.4% Superannuation
  
  

All Commission Locations
  
  

About the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
  
  

About the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
  
  

The Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission is the national regulator of Australian Government\-funded aged care services.
  
  

We protect and enhance the safety, health, wellbeing, and quality of life of people receiving aged care. This includes managing complaints and feedback about the care older people receive.
  
  

We help build confidence and trust in aged care, by promoting best practice and a culture of safety and quality in the sector. We register providers and hold them to account if they don’t meet expected standards of care.
  
  

We work with providers, workers, older people, their families, and supporters to make sure they understand and uphold older people’s rights.
  
  

Meet some of our people and learn more about the Commission and our Regulatory Strategy on our website www.agedcarequality.gov.au
  
  

About the Team
  
  

Cyber Section
  
  

Safeguarding the Commission’s digital assets, information, and infrastructure from cyber threats and security breaches, the Cyber team focuses on implementing robust security measures, policies, and practices to protect against unauthorised access, data breaches, and cyber\-attacks.
  
  

About the Role
  
  

The Assistant Director, Information Governance leads the team responsible for strengthening how the Commission creates, manages, protects, uses, retains and disposes of information. The role ensures information is treated as a strategic asset: trusted, discoverable, secure, accessible when needed and managed in line with legislative, policy and National Archives of Australia expectations.
  
  

As an EL1 leader in the Digital Group, the position connects information governance practice with the Commission’s regulatory purpose, digital and data priorities, risk appetite and service outcomes. The role provides practical leadership across information management, recordkeeping, assurance, cyber security, privacy and responsible technology use, helping the Commission make confident, evidence\-based decisions and maintain public trust.
  
  

Position Duties
  
  

**Lead information governance:** Develop and improve information governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures and guidance that align to business outcomes, regulatory responsibilities and the Commission’s digital and data priorities.
  
**Deliver recordkeeping and information management outcomes:** Support the proper creation, capture, management, preservation, access, retention and disposal of Commission information in line with the Archives Act, records authorities, National Archives of Australia guidance and Commission requirements.
  
**Strengthen information stewardship:** Improve ownership, classification, metadata, access, sensitivity, handling and lifecycle controls so information assets are discoverable, usable, trusted and appropriately protected.
  
**Manage information risk and assurance:** Identify, assess, manage and report information governance, recordkeeping, privacy, information handling and emerging technology risks, and coordinate assurance activities, remediation and reporting.
  
**Align with cyber security, privacy and the ISMS:** Work with cyber security, privacy, legal, technology and business stakeholders to embed information governance requirements into secure\-by\-design services, access controls, classification, incident response and business continuity practices.
  
**Support responsible technology use:** Provide practical governance for AI, automation, analytics and other emerging technologies, ensuring information inputs, outputs and records are managed according to value, sensitivity, ownership, retention, privacy, security and accountability requirements.
  
**Build capability and culture:** Develop clear guidance, education, communications and stakeholder engagement that help staff understand and meet their information management responsibilities.
  
**Provide strategic advice:** Give clear, evidence\-based advice to executives, managers and service owners on information governance, records management, information risk, privacy and lifecycle management.
  
**Lead the team and deliver results:** Set direction, clarify priorities, allocate work, build capability, manage performance, support wellbeing and deliver agreed outcomes while managing risks, dependencies and changing priorities.
  
**Drive continuous improvement:** Use evidence, feedback, reporting and lessons learned to improve information governance services, tools, registers, controls and assurance processes.
  
**Other duties:** Perform other duties as required, consistent with the classification, work level standards and direction of the Director.
  
  

**Position Eligibility Requirements (Selection Criteria):**  

To be successful in this role you will need to demonstrate the following:
  
  

**Strategic thinking:** Connects information governance work to the Commission’s purpose, regulatory responsibilities and digital and data priorities, using evidence and judgement to solve complex problems.
  
**Delivery and accountability:** Plans and delivers quality outcomes, manages priorities, risks and dependencies, and follows through on commitments with clear evidence and documentation.
  
**People and change leadership:** Provides direction, supports staff and stakeholders through change, builds capability and creates a positive, accountable and service\-oriented team culture.
  
**Stakeholder engagement:** Builds productive relationships across Digital, Data, Privacy, Legal, Governance, business areas, providers and government partners to achieve practical information governance outcomes.
  
**Communication and influence:** Explains complex information governance, recordkeeping, privacy, risk and assurance matters clearly and provides advice that supports informed decisions.
  
**Professional judgement and integrity:** Models ethical information handling, sound judgement, professionalism, resilience and a strong commitment to public accountability.
  
**Information governance expertise:** Applies strong knowledge of Australian Government information management, recordkeeping, lifecycle management, metadata, retention, disposal, discovery, preservation and relevant obligations, including the Archives Act, Privacy Act, PSPF and Commission policies.
  
**Risk, assurance and responsible digital practice:** Designs proportionate controls and assurance approaches for information, privacy, security and emerging technology risks, supporting trusted, secure and responsible digital and data outcomes.
  
**Security clearance:** Baseline Security Clearance, or ability to obtain and maintain.
  
  

**Position Notes:**  

Salary offered will be between $122,620 \- $139,850 per annum depending on skills and experience. In addition, 15\.4% superannuation will be paid.
  
Only candidates who hold Australian citizenship can apply. Appointment is conditional on successfully completing a national police check. For more information, please visit www.apsc.gov.au/citizenship\-aps
  
Non\-ongoing opportunity will be offered for an irregular/intermittent term. Opportunities will be offered for varying periods up to 12 months with the option to extend to a total of 24 months.
  
Merit Pool established through this selection process may be used to fill this or future ongoing or non\-ongoing vacancies.
  
In your application, please provide a statement of claims against the position eligibility requirements (selection criteria) in no more than 600\-words , including what strengths you would bring to the role, and a copy of your CV.
  
  

Please complete the application and submit by 1 October 2026 at 11:30PM
  
Follow our guidelines for candidate use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) throughout the recruitment process.
  
Please contact our recruitment team on (02\) 9633 3262 or email recruitment@agedcarequality.gov.au for assistance with accessing our website or with lodging your application.
  
  

Specific questions about the roles can be directed to Toby Harvey by emailing Toby.Harvey@agedcarequality.gov.au with Position title in the subject line.

The Commission is committed to fostering a workplace with flexible work arrangements to support a diverse, respectful and inclusive culture for all staff.

title: Fabrication Supervisor
description:
**Job Summary**

The Fabrication Supervisor oversees day\-to\-day shop floor operations, directing a team of fabricators, welders, and machine operators. This role ensures projects are completed on schedule, within design specifications, and in full compliance with safety and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Oversight:** Plan, schedule, and assign daily workloads for cutting, bending, forming, fit\-up, and welding operations to meet delivery deadlines.
* **Technical Guidance:** Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and weld symbols (WPS) to guide fabricators through complex assemblies.
* **Quality Assurance:** Inspect in\-process and finished assemblies for dimensional accuracy and weld integrity; ensure adherence to ASME, AWS, or project\-specific standards.
* **Safety \& Compliance:** Enforce OSHA regulations, site\-specific safety protocols, tool\-box talks, and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage across the shop floor.
* **Equipment \& Inventory Maintenance:** Oversee preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment (CNC plasma/laser cutters, press brakes, welding rigs) and monitor raw material stock (sheets, structural shapes, consumables).
* **Team Leadership:** Track crew performance, conduct hands\-on training, resolve shop floor bottlenecks, and manage timekeeping and attendance.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **Experience:** 10\+ years in metal fabrication/marine fabrication or structural steel manufacturing

Work Location: In person

title: QC Welding Inspector
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Welding Inspector** with 4–7 years of experience in **shipbuilding, ship repair, marine, fabrication, or heavy engineering**. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring and inspecting welding activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, WPS, ITPs, applicable standards, class requirements, and project specifications.

Key Responsibilities

* Inspect welding and fabrication activities at various stages of production.
* Verify welding work against **approved drawings, WPS, specifications and ITP requirements**.
* Check joint preparation, fit\-up, alignment, root gap, bevel angle and cleanliness before welding.
* Verify welder qualification and ensure qualified welders are deployed for the applicable welding process and position.
* Monitor welding parameters, preheating and interpass temperature as specified in the WPS.
* Conduct **visual inspection (VT)** of completed welds and identify welding defects.
* Coordinate with NDT personnel for **PT, MT, UT and RT** as applicable.
* Review NDT reports and ensure defects are properly repaired and re\-inspected.
* Verify welding consumables, storage, handling and traceability.
* Check material identification and traceability against relevant material certificates.
* Prepare and maintain inspection reports, checklists and quality records.
* Raise/coordinate **NCRs** for non\-conforming welding work and follow up on corrective actions.
* Coordinate with Production, Engineering, QA/QC and Class/Client representatives during inspections.
* Participate in stage inspections, hold points and final inspections.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of welding activities.
* Support preparation of quality dossiers and final inspection documentation.
* Ensure compliance with company HSE requirements while carrying out inspection activities.

Required Technical Knowledge

* Welding processes such as **SMAW, FCAW, GMAW/MIG\-MAG and GTAW/TIG**.
* Welding defects and their identification.
* WPS, PQR/WPQR and welder qualification requirements.
* Fit\-up and dimensional inspection.
* Basic knowledge of NDT methods and interpretation of NDT reports.
* ITP, inspection checklists and NCR procedures.
* Material identification and traceability.
* Engineering drawings and welding symbols.
* Basic knowledge of **shipbuilding/ship\-repair practices and Class requirements**.

Qualification

* **Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering or equivalent.**
* Welding Inspection certification such as **CSWIP 3\.1 / AWS CWI / equivalent** will be an advantage.
* NDT Level II certification in relevant methods will be preferred.

Experience

* **4–7 years of relevant experience** in welding inspection.
* Experience in **shipyard, ship repair, marine fabrication, offshore, pressure vessels or heavy engineering** is preferred.

Key Skills

* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to read and understand engineering drawings and welding symbols.
* Good inspection and reporting skills.
* Effective coordination with Production and Engineering teams.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently at a shipyard/site environment.
* Strong commitment to quality and safety.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
